verdict.rationale: API parity with the UI is a fair question for a SaaS-style authenticator and password-manager product, so the axis applies. The product's own llms.txt states 'Public API: None', and every OpenAPI probe path returned 404. The '2FAS API' mention covers service-provider 2FA enablement, not programmatic access to the user's in-app capabilities, so it earns no credit for UI parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
